records.subject: 围棋，局部木质棋盘黑白棋子
records.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: single 3D icon for a sports scorekeeping iOS app.
Edit the supplied reference icon style into the subject described below, replacing the original sports equipment entirely. The references are style/material/lighting guides: match their realistic subtly grainy satin materials, rounded manufactured edges, premium studio product render, restrained bright natural colors, soft upper-left lighting, small soft specular highlights, clean uncluttered silhouette. Avoid glossy candy/plastic cartoon exaggeration. Match the 8-ball/Bowling/Darts icon family.
Square composition, one centered isolated object group occupying about 80% of the canvas, roughly 10% safe transparent margin all around. Near frontal camera with mild three-quarter perspective and coherent physical depth. True transparent alpha background. No ground plane, podium, pedestal, container shape, backdrop, floating decorative shapes, extra sporting objects, cast shadow outside the object group, captions or watermarks.
Subject: Go (Weiqi) game equipment: a compact square corner section of a pale warm maple wooden Go board with fine accurate orthogonal black grid lines, gently beveled edges and physical board thickness; two large smooth low convex Go stones placed on grid intersections, one dark charcoal black in front-left, one ivory white behind-right, and one smaller black stone farther back. No chess/checkers pieces. Slightly elevated three-quarter angle showing grid and stones. Most of the icon is large readable black/white stones plus a small local board section. Matte-satin rounded natural stone texture, subtle realistic wood grain.
